open_s3_file_read: open an S3 file for reading using S3PathHandler and return a file-like object
open_s3_file_write: open an S3 file for writing using S3PathHandler and upload on close
download_s3_to_local: download an S3 object to a local cache path using S3PathHandler _get_local_path
upload_local_to_s3: copy a local file to an S3 path using S3PathHandler _copy_from_local
list_s3_directory: list the contents of an S3 directory prefix using S3PathHandler _ls
